final_message:
The fix is complete. The issue was that the original regex `[^a-z0-9]+` replaced all non-alphanumeric characters (including spaces) with dashes, causing multiple consecutive spaces to become multiple dashes. 

The fix changes the pattern to `\s+|[^a-zA-Z0-9]+`:
- `\s+` matches one or more whitespace characters and replaces them with a single dash
- `[^a-zA-Z0-9]+` matches any non-alphanumeric character (punctuation, symbols, etc.) and replaces each with a single dash

This ensures that:
1. Multiple consecutive spaces become a single dash (fixing the reported issue)
2. Single spaces still become dashes
3. All other punctuation is handled consistently

All 5 tests pass successfully.
